items.why: Extending Friday's 6% rally on AI optimism: reports of an in-house 'Iris' AI chip, bullish analyst targets including Wells Fargo's $1,000 call, and the stock back above its 200-day average.
Fear gauge rose as tech stocks slid: chips fell after their worst week in a month on AI spending doubts and China's CXMT advancing rival DRAM tech.
Caught in the broad chip selloff: profit-taking after a record run, ARK trimming its position, and shares breaking below $620 support.
Crude climbed as Houthi rebels struck Riyadh's airport over the weekend and Russia kept hitting Ukrainian energy sites, keeping supply risk priced in.

market_note: S&P futures flat near 7,852; Nasdaq futures down 0.7% with chips leading lower; oil up near $94.
summary: Stocks started the week mixed: tech sold off after the chip sector's worst week in a month, while Dow futures rose. Oil holding above $100 kept inflation worries alive with bank earnings and CPI due this week.
